title: Watercolor Mother and Baby Clipart
author: Lemocheka Art
description:
Watercolor Mother and Baby Clipart for your any DIY project!
You can print this PNG to:
– T-shirts, pillows, towels or any other tapestry of your choice
– make your own adorable planner stickers, planner clips and planner dividers
– mugs and cups
– print and arrange as a picture
– ideal for party invitations, card making, scrapbooking, stationary and blogs or any DIY project
You will receive 4 PNG files ranging in size from 3000px on the minimum side to 4000px on the maximum side with a high resolution of 300 dpi with transparent backgrounds.
Actual colors may vary slightly due to monitor settings. Depending on how you choose to print out the image, colors and quality may vary.
This is a DIGITAL file – no physical product will be shipped.
